description: Enrich a list of up to 100 companies in one synchronous call. Each input row must include a (country, registry_id) pair. Returns per-row match_status, the company record, and any error as an embedded RFC 9457 problem. Designed for CRM enrichment, due-diligence batches, and KYB screens. For more than 100 rows, split client-side and call firmadb_estimate_cost first. Idempotent: pass an idempotency_key (UUID) to safely retry without double-billing. Pricing: per verified match. References that 404 are not billed.
name: firmadb_enrich_companies
